title: What If Magento 3 Was Built from Scratch with AI?
excerpt: One developer. 30 days. Claude Code. The Marko framework is what Magento could have been if Adobe had started over with modern PHP and AI-first development.

content:
One developer. 30 days. Claude Code. The Marko framework is what Magento could have been if Adobe had started over with modern PHP and AI-first development.

In this issue

  • What Marko Is. Marko isn't a fork or a refactor. It's a new PHP framework built on PHP 8.5 that takes the best architectural ideas from Magento (dependency injection, modularity, the plugin system, the module ecosystem) and rebuilds them without the complexity.
  • 30 Days. One Developer. Claude Code. Mark built the entire core architecture of Marko in about 30 days.
  • Marko Talk: The Proof of Concept. To prove the framework works, Mark built Marko Talk, a real-time messaging app (think simplified Slack) running on the Marko framework.
  • Where Adobe Is Going. Mark didn't hold back on Adobe's direction.
  • The Magento Community Still Matters. Mark is quick to credit the community projects keeping the ecosystem alive.
  • If You're a Merchant Reading This. If you're running Magento 2.4.x in production and your store is working, don't panic.
  • The Bigger Story. Mark didn't just prompt an AI to build a framework.
